title: Knowing Myself
purpose: Move from adjective collection to testable self-knowledge that can guide independent decisions.
transfer: Complete your profile using one strength, interest, value and working condition. Add the evidence and one next test for each.

title: Goals That Work
purpose: Let pupils see the effect of changing specificity, route or evidence one at a time.
transfer: Write one goal, three steps and one check. Cover the model and use your own checklist to decide whether another pupil could start it.

title: Working With Others
purpose: Make hidden team processes observable so pupils can choose a strategy independently during later group work.
transfer: Choose one teamwork function to practise. Record the cue you will notice, the action you will take and the evidence after the task.

title: Managing Myself
purpose: Give pupils a reusable visual routine and a dignified recovery path.
transfer: Run the routine on one real lesson task. Record the planned prompt, checkpoint, recovery action and one change for next time.

title: Solving Problems
purpose: Help pupils transfer a stable problem-solving method to practical and social tasks.
transfer: Use the method on one supplied scenario. Record problem, two options, chosen action, check and next decision.

title: Present My Progress
purpose: Teach pupils to curate and explain progress rather than depend on an adult to assemble a celebration narrative.
transfer: Build a three-minute progress presentation: starting point / change evidence / strategy or support / next goal.

title: Our Patch, Our Say
purpose: Strengthen enquiry and protect against assumptions before the group chooses a project.
transfer: Complete the observation sheet for one agreed place or service. Separate: what I saw / what I think / what must be checked.

title: Choose the Need
purpose: Make a group decision process visible and repeatable, allowing pupils to justify rather than defend preferences.
transfer: Score the shortlisted needs using the class matrix. Record the chosen need, one rejected option and the evidence-led reason.

title: Roles, Steps, Resources
purpose: Externalise project planning so pupils can independently locate the next step and recover from disruption.
transfer: Complete the team plan. Use arrows to show dependencies and name the first review point.

title: First Contact
purpose: Build independent drafting skill while keeping external contact behind centre approval.
transfer: Draft the real message on the approved template. Annotate purpose, evidence, request, adult route and privacy check.

title: Risk & Ready
purpose: Teach pupils to participate meaningfully in risk planning without implying they authorise activity.
transfer: Complete the pupil planning section, then take it through the named adult review. Record the authorised controls exactly.

title: Green Light
purpose: Give pupils a transparent readiness test and permission to stop at ‘not yet confirmed’.
transfer: Complete the green-light sheet with the responsible adult. Any missing item remains open with an owner and next check date.

title: Helps and Earns
purpose: Prevent ‘helps and earns’ from becoming a vague slogan by separating linked but distinct functions.
transfer: Analyse one supplied enterprise example using customer value, income, cost and social benefit, then add one missing question.

title: Spot the Gap
purpose: Develop observation and user-empathy before idea generation.
transfer: Complete a gap card: user / current problem / evidence / existing workaround / constraint / question to test.

title: Our Idea, Our Users
purpose: Make user-centred design visible and require a causal link between consultation and product decision.
transfer: Complete: For [user], who needs [evidence], our offer provides [feature], which helps by [benefit].

title: Money In, Money Out
purpose: Allow pupils to manipulate the variables behind break-even and compare one change at a time.
transfer: Complete the supplied fictional calculation independently. Show sales income, total cost, difference and one assumption to test.

title: Brand and Pitch
purpose: Keep pupils from spending all planning time on logos and effects while core enterprise reasoning remains weak.
transfer: Build the pitch storyboard: hook / need / offer / demonstration / simple money / benefit / ask.

title: Pitch Day
purpose: Help pupils receive feedback as evidence and independently convert it into a bounded decision.
transfer: After the real pitch, choose one authentic feedback point. Record keep / change / test and the reason in your own words.
